supersedes_input_of: 2.0.0 (adds METAR 6-hour maximum groups to the observed max so far; v2.0 artifact unchanged)
method: As v2.0, with M = round(max(hourly/special ASOS tmpf, METAR 6-h max groups whose whole 6-h period lies inside the window)). Anchor max_obs_guidance; levels hour -> hour_gap -> hour_gap_drop -> station_hour_gap -> station_hour_gap_drop; selected on 2025-01..06 validation exact-degree log loss.

below_obs_max.definition: y < M: final CLI max below the rounded observed max so far (hourly tmpf + 6-h max groups), pooled across stations

six_hour_max_rule.counted_if: valid_at - 6 h >= window start AND valid_at < window end AND available_at <= now
six_hour_max_rule.source: IEM ASOS archive raw METAR (data=metar, routine reports), decoded by parseMetarSixHour

rounding_conversion_risk.definition: E at the 22 LST cutoff (training): CLI max minus round(max(hourly tmpf, usable 6-h max))

guidance_rule: NBM (NBS) day max; run usable at cycle + 5 h and <= 24 h old; GFS fallback unvalidated (engine fails closed by default)
target: NOAA RCC-ACIS daily max at the CLI site (final NWS CLI)
publication: rawProbability is the calibrated table value; probability is whole-percent with a 1%/99% publication-precision floor/ceiling (not a model bound)

holdout.gate_rule: RESEARCH only if the 95% date-cluster bootstrap CI of (baseline - v2.1) is > 0 on the full holdout for 2-degree-bucket Brier AND bucket log loss vs v2.0, pre-window v1.1, persistence and climatology-of-remaining
